aci.name: ACI
aci.summary: Adapts the working miscoverage level alpha_t += gamma (alpha - err_t). Long-run coverage holds for any sequence.

agaci.name: AgACI
agaci.summary: Aggregates ACI experts with online expert aggregation on the pinball loss.

belief.name: Bayesian belief CP
belief.reference: Zhang, Bombara & Yang, The Benefit of Being Bayesian in Online Conformal Prediction, 2024
belief.summary: Threshold = quantile of a belief: a prior mixed with the discounted empirical score distribution.

bocpd.name: BOCPD
bocpd.summary: Bayesian online changepoint detection with a Normal-Inverse-Gamma model per regime; threshold = predictive quantile.

bocpd_aci.name: BOCPD + ACI
bocpd_aci.summary: Bayesian changepoint predictive, with its level set by ACI so long-run coverage holds.

cpcp.name: Changepoint CP
cpcp.reference: Barber et al. 2023 weights from Adams & MacKay 2007
cpcp.summary: Weighted split conformal; a past score's weight is the posterior probability it is in the current regime.

dtaci.name: DtACI

interval.description: Local-regret interval that sets the learning rates.
interval.title: Interval

dtaci.summary: Runs ACI over a grid of step sizes and reweights the experts online, so the step size tunes itself.

eci.name: ECI

c.description: Slope of the smoothed miss indicator, per unit of the recent score range.
c.title: Sigmoid slope

h.description: Apply the error term only beyond this share of the range.
h.title: Cutoff

lr.description: Step as a fraction of the recent score range.
lr.title: Learning rate

eci.reference: Wu, Hu, Bao, Xia & Zou, ICLR 2025
eci.summary: Quantile tracker plus an error-quantification term that also weighs how far the score fell from the threshold. Trades some coverage for width.

nexcp.name: NexCP

rho.description: Weight of a score one step older.
rho.title: Decay

nexcp.reference: Barber, Candes, Ramdas & Tibshirani, Ann. Stat. 2023
nexcp.summary: Weighted split conformal with geometric weights rho^age, robust to drift.

nig.name: Discounted Bayes
nig.summary: Gaussian score with unknown mean and variance, evidence discounted per step; Student-t predictive quantile.

pid.name: Conformal PID

ki.description: In units of the recent score range.
ki.title: Integrator gain

pid.summary: Quantile tracker plus a saturated integrator of past coverage errors.

qt.name: Quantile tracker

lr.description: Step as a fraction of the recent score range.
lr.title: Learning rate

qt.summary: Online gradient descent on the pinball loss of the threshold itself: q += eta (err - alpha).

saocp.name: SAOCP

g.description: An expert started at t lives g * 2^(trailing zeros of t) steps.
g.title: Lifetime

saocp.summary: SF-OGD experts on geometric covering intervals, combined by coin betting: low regret on every time interval.

sfogd.name: SF-OGD
sfogd.reference: Orabona & Pal 2016; Bhatnagar et al., ICML 2023
sfogd.summary: Scale-free gradient descent on the pinball loss, with no learning rate to tune.

split.name: Rolling split CP
split.reference: Vovk et al. 2005; rolling calibration window
split.summary: Empirical (1-alpha)(1+1/n) quantile of the last W scores. Valid under exchangeability, slow to react to shifts.
